scientific.integrity: The sign error probability is computed exactly from the uniform additive-noise law. Under the support-lattice commensurability condition, the recurrent chain is exactly the Ehrenfest birth-death chain; detailed balance and exact conditional moments give the invariant law and noise floor.
limitations: The binomial closed form requires the noise support endpoints to lie on the signSGD lattice.
The theorem is scalar, one-worker, constant-step, and uses iid uniform additive noise.
The invariant law exists uniquely but the chain is period two, so deterministic-start distributions do not converge without parity conditioning.
Generic nonaligned lattice offsets lead to different finite birth-death weights.

title: Exact Ehrenfest law and linear noise floor for additive-noise signSGD
